fulfillment_mode_hints.outright: One-shot purchase. Spawns a single purchase order on approval; no recurrence, no inventory side-effect.
fulfillment_mode_hints.stockable: Replenishment buy. Spawns a purchase order; received goods credit inventory on receipt.
fulfillment_mode_hints.recurring: Standing agreement. Spawns a supplier contract on approval; the recurrence engine emits cycle bills.
fulfillment_mode_hints.petty: Cash-out. Spawns an expenditure directly against petty cash. No PO, no contract.

procurement_request.fulfillment_strategy_hint: Auto-derived from the per-line fulfillment modes. Mixed strategy means lines split across multiple modes.
procurement_request.policy_decision_log_info: Audit trail of approval policy decisions taken on this request (auto-approve, escalation, override). Read-only.
